page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.30xlarge is an enterprise-grade memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. The virtual machine delivers 120 dedicated vCPUs powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8490H processor operating at a base frequency of 1.9 GHz. Accompanied by 2048.0 GB of system memory, the instance maintains a high memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio of approximately 17.07 GB per core, targeting environments requiring extreme RAM footprints.

Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, accommodating high-throughput inter-node data transfers and distributed memory synchronization. The instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage, meaning all persistent and temporary disk operations require attached network block volumes. Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs provisioned on this configuration.

The primary resource tradeoff centers on massive memory capacity against standard compute clock frequencies and the absence of onboard storage. The 1.9 GHz clock rate is tuned for dense parallel execution rather than single-core compute performance. Cost efficiency is driven by the density of the 2 TB memory allocation, reducing the infrastructure footprint by consolidating large datasets onto a single virtual node rather than clustering across multiple smaller instances.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.30xlarge is engineered specifically for memory-bound enterprise operations. Typical deployments include massive in-memory databases such as SAP HANA and Redis clusters, large-scale graph analytics, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy transactional databases that exceed standard 1:4 or 1:8 memory-to-CPU ratios.

This profile makes ecs.re8.30xlarge well configured for massive in-memory databases, distributed caching, real-time analytics engines, and enterprise SAP HANA workloads.
